sandbox.name: Podman
sandbox.detail: Podman 4.9.3 ready (rootless; kernel 6.17.0-1022-azure), needed for every Session and every axocoatl run

sandbox.name: User ID ranges
sandbox.detail: runner has no range of subordinate user and group IDs in /etc/subuid and /etc/subgid, so rootless Podman cannot unpack images or start Sessions
sandbox.fix: sudo usermod --add-subuids 165536-231071 --add-subgids 165536-231071 runner && podman system migrate
